expected.prerequisiteOrLesson: Wired 802.1X, EAP-TLS 1.3. Initially unauthorized switch port; EAP identity exchange; Access-Request/Challenge rounds carrying EAP-TLS; certificate and Finished checks; protected success, EAP/RADIUS result, then port enforcement.
expected.requiredTerminalBoundary: The controlled port opens only after the accepted result is processed. State explicitly that this does not establish MACsec or prove Internet reachability.

predicates.terminalPredicate: Port unauthorized until Access-Accept received, verified and applied; no MACsec

invalid-Message-Authenticator.propagation: Server silently discards invalid-integrity request; no fabricated Access-Reject. NAS times out and never admits port.

knowledge.netServer: Knows adjacent packet integrity failed, not that the peer certificate is invalid.
knowledge.netNas: No authenticated response; timeout only.

wrong-RADIUS-Identifier.propagation: NAS discards mismatched reply; it does not deliver EAP-TLS Start to peer or admit port.

knowledge.netNas: Reply does not correlate to outstanding RADIUS request.
knowledge.netPeer: Does not receive a successfully relayed Start from this response.

wrong-EAP-Identifier.propagation: NAS discards mismatched EAP response; no backend Access-Request for that response and no fabricated server rejection.

knowledge.netNas: Local EAP identifier mismatch.
knowledge.netServer: No forwarded identity response from this failed input.

reordered-EAP-Message.propagation: Configured malformed-method path rejects the EAP exchange; NAS verifies rejection and relays EAP-Failure; no successful TLS exporter or port admission.

knowledge.netServer: Malformed ordered EAP input, not a certificate-chain failure.
knowledge.netNas: Receives verified method rejection before lower-layer failure relay.

fragment-sequence.propagation: Configured malformed-method path rejects exchange; no hidden successful reassembly and no port admission.

knowledge.netServer: Invalid EAP-TLS fragmentation state; no completed peer certificate validation.
knowledge.netNas: Can enforce only the verified method failure, not infer a valid full handshake.

boundaryAssertions.initial: No newly authenticated access session; existing-session profiles explicitly start with only their named sessions
boundaryAssertions.receipt: Receiver acquires only the exact packet representation, no trusted authorization
boundaryAssertions.localCheck: Failed check cannot produce successful state or new permitted secret export
boundaryAssertions.terminal: Port unauthorized until Access-Accept received, verified and applied; no MACsec

groupedOmissions.accessTLS: Wire values/handles are symbolic. No live AAA, CA/OCSP capture, production packet encoder or runtime cryptography is claimed.
groupedOmissions.accountService: NPS uses explicitly labeled scoped documented account-policy boundaries only; no fabricated LDAP or Kerberos subflow.
groupedOmissions.protectedLink: Wired admission does not prove MACsec or Internet reachability. Wi-Fi stops at EAP access decision, wifiUsable=false, no four-way handshake/PTK/GTK installation.
groupedOmissions.vendorSupport: Only the documented Windows Server 2022 NPS / Windows 11 24H2 TLS 1.2 configuration is modeled, with no exact tested patch build, TLS 1.3 NPS or RADIUS/1.1 NPS support claim.

expected.authorship: Independent manifest and worksheet; not inferred from model execution
expected.prerequisiteOrLesson: Accounting lifecycle. An already established service sends Accounting-Request Start, configured Interim-Update records and Stop, each with its Accounting-Response.
expected.requiredTerminalBoundary: One stable session correlation, cumulative counters, separate delivery acknowledgements. A missing accounting reply does not automatically revoke network access.

predicates.terminalPredicate: One session correlation; Start Interim Stop persisted and individually acknowledged

lost-accounting-response.propagation: Collector durable Start remains stored once. NAS retries same logical Start with delay2/id64 and recomputed accounting authenticator; collector deduplicates and acknowledges, then ordinary Interim/Stop continue.

knowledge.netCollector: Knows Start durable before any response delivery.
knowledge.netNas: Initially delivery pending, not remote failure; learns ACK only after validating retry response.

duplicate-accounting-request.propagation: Collector returns Accounting-Response without appending a second logical Start; NAS validates ACK once; Interim and Stop remain separate logical records.

algorithms.framing: uint64 little-endian byte lengths; fixed-width 32-byte big-endian scalars
algorithms.keySchedule: K_main=SHA256(TT); HKDF nil salt, ConfirmationKeys -> two 32-byte keys; SharedKey -> 32-byte K_shared

transports: Abstract ordered public teaching transport; no standardized transport binding claimed
Teaching-only authenticated confidential out-of-band administrative enrollment
assumptions: Immutable synthetic vector-reference fixtures; no runtime cryptography
RFC vector supplies password-equivalent inputs directly; password/PBKDF/MHF mapping is not specified by the vector
Roles, identities, group and transcript framing are pinned; no editable crypto context
Ordinary public recording and explicitly disclosed verifier record are different observer capabilities.
profile.completion: Each endpoint verifies the peer confirmation and hands its own required confirmation to the transport before its output key is usable in this bounded profile. Local handoff is distinct from remote receipt/verification; a reciprocal sender can finish while its reply is in flight. No application authorization, ticket, cookie or OAuth token is implied.
